work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult CCXVIII grants the rochet to the provost and canons of Castelnuovo Scrivia (diocese of Tortona); LF48240 → LF48252 across CCXVII’s provenance LF48243, own provenance LF48246 and running title LF48249; LF48313 → LF48319 across page number 329 LF48316; complete 28 May 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF48231–48231; the source closing at LF48319–48322 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima octava maii mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, ponti- ficatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
